title: Cobblemon Delta
description: Pokemon Cobblemon Pack - QoL and Performance mods! The server included in the pack has Mega Evolution, Paradox Pokemon, Area Zero, Real Player Gyms, Raids, Dungeons, Pokemon Fishing!
body:
This pack includes a few QOL and Performance mods along side Cobblemon, an expansive Pokémon mod!  This pack is Highly Optimized and runs good on low end hardware. We Recommend Setting your Ram to 4gb. 

This pack is on Cobblemon 1.7.3, the latest version of Cobblemon!

Join Cobblemon Delta via the multiplayer section to play with friends and many other things!

<details>
<summary>Server Features</summary>

- Raids
- Gyms
- Dungeons
- Join/Create Towns
- Breeding
- Wonder Trade System
- GTS (Grand Trading System from Pokemmo)
- Battle Frontier
- Shiny Weekends
- Alpha Pokemon
- Game Corner
- Daycare
- Player Shops
- Champion Tournaments
- Land Claims
- Seasonal Events
- Outbreaks
- Hunting/Breeding Bounties
- Server Block/Item Shop
- and more!

<details>
<summary>Resource Packs</summary>

- 3D Crops (Disabled Default)
- Kiece Cobblemon Minimap Icons (Enabled Default)
- Kiece Icons v4.1 VCompat (Enabled Default)
- Cobblemon Emissive Ores (Disabled Default)
- Poke Plaques (Enabled Default)
- Held Item Descriptions (Enabled Default)
- TPC Vitamin Descriptions (Enabled Default)

 </details>

Join our Discord for more info: https://discord.gg/cobblemondelta

Server IP: play.cobblemondelta.com

gallery.title: Ultra Space
gallery.description: Explore Ultra Space on our server! Explore and build in Ultra Space or look for Ultra Nests which spawn Ultra Beasts!

gallery.title: Gyms
gallery.description: Fight gyms for ingame items and shiny pokemon! Also you'll be able to participate in the champions tournament upon gaining all 8 badges!

gallery.title: Community Day
gallery.description: This is our last community day's exclusive pokemon!

gallery.title: Raids
gallery.description: Participate in raids to capture high level pokemon, including legendaries!

gallery.title: Dungeons
gallery.description: Complete dungeons for ingame rewards and legendary pokemon!

gallery.title: Custom Pokemon!
gallery.description: Here's a few custom eeveelutions we have!

gallery.title: Fishing
gallery.description:
On Cobblemon Delta we have a custom fishing system! If you've ever played the game Stardew Valley it'll be familiar to you. It's inspired by their fishing mini-game.

You can fish up Magikarp Jump forms, Kyogre, Manaphy, and Volcanion in lava fishing!

gallery.title: Legendary Pokemon Battles
gallery.description: Each Legendary Pokemon is obtained in a unique way on Cobblemon Delta. For some you have to fight them with Minecraft weapons until they are weak enough to catch!

gallery.title: Mega Evolution
gallery.description: Cobblemon Delta is the first server to have fully functional Mega Evolution! You can find Mega Stones in Dungeons or Area Zero!

gallery.title: Area Zero
gallery.description: Explore Area Zero to find Paradox Pokemon! Paradox Pokemon are aggressive and will attack you. You'll need to have weapons and armor ready to fight them. Once you lower their health you can catch them!

gallery.title: Champion Tournament
gallery.description: The winner of the Champion Tournament becomes the Champion of the server! Champion Tournaments happen each gym season. Gym seasons last about a month. The winner receives a Victini as well as some other rewards.
